text:
sam: Proposal: add a "slim cost pill" to model list showing tokens, cache credits, est $/1k for 1h. lightweight and one-line.

rachel: nice. product wants both raw tokens and normalized cost. show normalized by default.

leo: big warning: analytics aggregates are sampled. we can't call CH per page load.

infra-bot: FYI model_burn_agg sampling_rate=0.08-0.2 depending on tenant; rollup window=10s.

anya: suggest sample_fraction in response + confidence indicator (pattern + color). gray low-confidence rows.

sam: backend idea: streaming upserts from CH -> redis hash by tenant+model, TTL 30s. console backend reads once per user session.

rachel: quotas: if tenant is quota-throttled tokens look low. add quota_limited boolean and a tiny warning link to quota timeline.

leo: implement router counter quota_event per tenant/minute and join on tenant_id in streaming job.

sam: API sketch: GET /internal/console/v1/model_pill?model=...&tenant=...&window=1h -> model, tokens, cache_saved, cost_per_1k_usd, sample_fraction, quota_limited 

anya: rollout: internal preview only, opt-in toggle, measure expand CTR + error rate.

leo: ops risk: consoles could fan-out same read across many users. mitigate: server-side render pill, debounce per 30s, enforce read quota.

infra-bot: recommend rate-limit 100 reads/sec per cluster and a circuit breaker to degrade to cached stale values.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/slim-cost-pill -> staging 2026-03-26T11:00:00Z

rachel: accessibility: confidence must be color-blind accessible (patterns + color).

sam: I'll write RFC and prototype endpoint. leo will wire streaming upsert. anya will mock UI states. Thanks. :thumbsup:
